body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> BIXOLON(www.samsungminiprinters.com), a spin-off of Samsung, presented its mobile printer ‘SPP-R200’ during CES 2008.

As a mini mobile receipt printer, it enables you to print out receipts or labels when you are on the move. By adopting rigid plastic and special rubber, it is strong enough even when you drop it from 1.2m height.

The SPP-R200, an awardee of ‘2007 Good Design’, employed the company’s patented ‘touch slide’ for its magnetic card reader and used LEDs: blue for displaying remained battery, green for Bluetooth and red for condition of the printer.

Additionally, a leather case and a belt are offered as optional accessories and a multiple battery charger is included as a bundle. Its battery life continues up to 8 hours(14 hours at standby mode) per charge.
